_comment: The opt-in keys of [verify] and what they resolve to (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 52).
Each case is a policy.toml [verify] block (after `command = "x"`) and `resolves`: the fields the
resolved block must carry. `absent` lists fields it must not carry, because a key nobody declared
adds nothing to what runs. Asserted by packages/gnomon-core/src/verify_setup.test.ts.

cases.name: a timeout of the check's own
a setup, network shut by default
a setup with the registry open
an unknown setup_network is read as none
